items.name: god-mode
items.say: /god-mode build me a landing page
items.get: Picks the one skill or agent that fits and applies the working rules and token protocol
items.asks: nothing

items.name: setup
items.say: /god-mode:setup
items.get: The category picker: add or remove categories
items.asks: which categories you want

items.name: standing-rules
items.say: (loaded automatically)
items.get: Safety and quality rules: no deletes without OK, drafts not sends, backups before production writes
items.asks: nothing

items.name: design-color-rules
items.say: pick a palette for my app
items.get: Harmonies, 60-30-10, OKLCH shade scales, WCAG contrast checks
items.asks: your brand color, if any

categories.name: Web & Design
categories.description: Copy a website you like into a Next.js project, recolor a design image with a new palette, and get a scored review of a site or dashboard on a phone.

items.name: clone-website
items.say: clone https://example.com into Next.js
items.get: A working Next.js copy, built section by section with its assets and styles
items.asks: the URL(s), and whether you own the site or have the right to copy it

items.name: color-palette-swap
items.say: recolor this design with this palette (attach both images)
items.get: Two recolored PNGs: a light-to-light match and an aesthetic alternative
items.asks: the design file (PSD/PNG/JPG) and the palette image

items.name: mobile-ui-reviewer
items.say: review my site on mobile
items.get: Scores per area plus exact CSS/HTML fixes, checked at 360–430px
items.asks: the URL, which pages, and whether to fix or only report

items.name: dashboard-reviewer
items.say: review my admin dashboard
items.get: Scores and the top 3 fixes for layout, data correctness and design consistency
items.asks: the URL or screenshots, and who uses it for what

categories.name: QA & Audit
categories.description: Test a mobile app before you publish it, or find out why a website is broken or slow, with a backup and rollback for every fix.

items.name: mobile-app-qa
items.say: test this build before I upload it
items.get: A bug report with steps and evidence, and a GO / NO-GO verdict
items.asks: the app, the platforms, what changed, and a test server and account

items.name: web-auditor
items.say: my site is stuck loading / shows 500
items.get: Cause, fix, proof it works, and the rollback command
items.asks: the URL, the symptom, where the code is, and whether to fix or only report

categories.name: SEO & Writing
categories.description: Get found on Google and in AI answers, make AI-sounding text read like a person wrote it, and write bilingual Saudi/Gulf news articles.

items.name: seo-ai-visibility
items.say: why isn't my site showing on Google or in ChatGPT?
items.get: A ranked fix list: robots, sitemap, llms.txt, schema, hreflang, speed
items.asks: the site URL, languages, the pages that matter, and whether to allow AI crawlers

items.name: humanizer
items.say: make this sound less like AI (paste text)
items.get: The same text with AI tells removed and every fact kept
items.asks: nothing beyond the text

items.name: saudi-news-curator
items.say: هات تريند السعودية النهارده and write an SEO article
items.get: A verified Arabic + English article with SEO title, meta and hashtags
items.asks: your site URL (once) and the topic or section

categories.name: Video & Marketing
categories.description: Turn a product or a raw recording into a promo film, a trailer or vertical shorts with captions, plus the post and store text to go with it.
categories.extras: Optional video toolkit (ffmpeg, faster-whisper, video tools) ≈1 GB, offered separately and only if you say yes.

items.name: promo-film-maker
items.say: make a 30-second promo for my app
items.get: A storyboard to approve, the rendered video, then caption, hashtags and store text
items.asks: the product, the platform (9:16 or 16:9), length, language, and the one message to remember

categories.name: Career
categories.description: Fix your CV and LinkedIn for ATS, check which jobs you really fit, and get a tailored CV and application drafts for each one. You send them.

items.name: cv-optimizer
items.say: analyze my CV for this job (paste both)
items.get: Line-by-line fixes, an ATS keyword check, and before/after rewrites
items.asks: your full CV, the job description, years, top achievements with numbers, and your target market

items.name: job-hunter
items.say: apply to this job (paste the post)
items.get: A fit verdict, a tailored CV, form answers and an email draft, logged
items.asks: your profile once (CV, skills, roles, locations, salary range) and any number it can't find

items.name: accounts-keeper
items.say: which job sites am I registered on?
items.get: A registry of your job-site accounts and their status
items.asks: which sites, and which Google account to use. You type passwords and codes

categories.name: Automation & Agents
categories.description: Pull data from a website without scraping the page, and hand a big task to a manager agent that splits it across specialists.

items.name: api-anything
items.say: get the flight prices from A to B on <site>
items.get: The data straight from the site's own requests, or a reusable operation
items.asks: the site and what you want from it; you sign in yourself

items.name: office-manager
items.say: someone handle the launch checklist
items.get: The task split across the right agents, with a combined report
items.asks: one question at most, when a decision is yours

categories.name: Study
categories.description: Upload a lecture and get one printable PDF: mind maps, diagrams, exam traps and a question bank with answers.

items.name: lecture-summary-pdf
items.say: لخّص المحاضرة دي (attach the PDF)
items.get: An A4 summary PDF with mind maps, diagrams, exam traps, MCQ + True/False and an answer key
items.asks: how many questions, whether you want a recap in your language, and pages to skip

categories.name: Interior Design
categories.description: Plan a room from your photos and measurements: layout, furniture, lighting, a bill of quantities and a mood board.

items.name: interior-design-engineer
items.say: design my living room 4×5 m (attach photos)
items.get: Layout options, furniture and lighting plan, BOQ, and a mood board
items.asks: room photos and measurements, inspiration images, budget and style
